findings.reason: as written the node's stated mechanism cannot satisfy its done-when, so the author must re-point the reuse at the leaf roots (or the section is only discoverable by its fallback).
findings.text: §14 states that re-seeding `/analysis/src` "lists it again and persist_scan_results creates child rows for its direct children", but its own mechanism cannot do this: persist_scan_results creates children only in the expansion branch (is_expanding=True), while a first scan sets status='scanned' with should_create_children=False (frontier.py:1929-1941); expansion then claims only paths matching `status=triaged AND should_expand=true AND expanded_at IS NULL` (imas_codex/discovery/paths/parallel.py:547-549). `/analysis/src` already carries expanded_at (its children SAselene/edas2 exist), and grep of imas_codex/discovery finds no writer that ever clears expanded_at — create_nodes does `SET n += item` and the seed item omits the key, and neither PATH_RESET_SPECS entry clears it (imas_codex/discovery/base/reset.py:240-255). So the seeded re-listing cannot create the three trees and the section stops at its own fallback. The same section's first diagnostic is also unsupported: the facility `excludes:` block (imas_codex/config/facilities/jt-60sa.yaml:57-65) and the default patterns (imas_codex/config/patterns/exclude.yaml) hold no pattern matching `client_eqdbms.EQ32.Rev1` or `SAeqfame`, so there is nothing to narrow. The mechanism the section should name is already present — `seed_facility_roots(facility, root_paths=…)` creates a row for each path passed (frontier.py:526-538), reached from the CLI as `discover paths jt-60sa --root <path>` (imas_codex/cli/discover/paths.py:258-265) — so passing the three leaf trees as roots seeds their rows directly.

findings.reason: the author should name the module that owns the fragment — imas_codex/graph/vector_search.py already owns the rendered-Cypher helper set and is imported by both graph and discovery callers — so the three sites extend one owner rather than each importing a new one.
findings.text: §19 says the `coalesce(ce.source_file, cc.source_file)` expression is "extracted once as a rendered fragment beside the other shared Cypher helpers" but never names where that is, and there is no such shared module: `build_vector_search` lives in imas_codex/graph/vector_search.py:17, the clause helpers in imas_codex/graph/dd_domain_classifier.py:359-1097, and the two existing copies of the expression sit in different packages (imas_codex/graph/domain_queries.py:483 and imas_codex/llm/search_tools.py:1659). A consolidation without a named owner can become a fourth location imported by a third package (discovery/signals), which is the duplicate the section exists to remove.

rubric_items.deep_module: pass — neither open section adds a module that spreads complexity across shallow wrappers; §19 is one consolidation plus one measurement, §14 is a single operator run through existing paths.
rubric_items.duplicate_owner: a finding — §19 consolidates `coalesce(ce.source_file, cc.source_file)` into "a rendered fragment beside the other shared Cypher helpers" but names no owning module, and no single shared-Cypher-fragments module exists, so the fragment can land as a fourth location reachable from a third package.
rubric_items.interface_budget: pass — public_definitions 0, cli_options 0, mcp_views 0, refusal_families 0; §19 adds no CLI option, MCP view or refusal family and names the three sites it merges, and §14 adds no interface, so nothing retires or is declined.
rubric_items.reuse_search: a finding — §14 reuses `discover paths --root` / `seed_facility_roots` but its account of what that machinery does is wrong: re-seeding the parent `/analysis/src` does not create child rows, and the existing capability to seed the three leaf trees directly is not named.
rubric_items.thin_wrapper: pass — §19's shared fragment is an extracted expression (not a wrapper over existing machinery) and matches the repo's existing rendered-Cypher helper pattern (`build_vector_search`, `_ids_filter_clause`); §14 adds no layer at all.
